title: Chapter 771
text:
"What is the Red Empire doing?" Joad was dumbfounded. He did not understand why the Red Empire would suddenly attack the Arcane Church. Weren't we on the same side today?

Ralph was also shocked by the sudden situation. The Red Empire and the Arcane Church were both enemies, so why did they suddenly turn against each other?

The Arcane Church hurriedly adjusted their formation and faced the Red Empire from the side. They blocked the bombardment while trying to counterattack. The Red Empire was behind the Bloodshed Land's formation, so the Bloodshed Land fleet and Klent fleet were caught in the crossfire.

Sisko's expression changed, and he quickly moved away from Heber.

"Is this your idea?"

All kinds of guesses appeared in his mind. Was Heber's betrayal taking revenge on him for interfering, or had it been planned all along? Could it be that Heber was so crazy that not only did he want to use Black Star to establish his dominance, but he also wanted to put him on the list?

Or was it that the Red Empire wanted to take this opportunity to get rid of him, an ally of the Arcane Church in the Shattered Star Ring?

Sisko could not help but let his imagination run wild. However, he realized that Heber had a confused look on his face, as if he did not know why his backer had suddenly attacked.

Heber did not have the time to care about Sisko's thoughts. He turned into a meteor and flew back to the Bloodshed Land's formation, entered the nearest spaceship, and borrowed the communicator.

"Joad! Contact the Red Empire and ask them what they are doing! "

"Your Excellency Tyrant, their commander asked us to cooperate with them to attack the Arcane Church, but he did not say why!" Joad quickly replied in the communication channel.

Heber's eyes were solemn. "Contact the Klent people and ask them to ask the Empire's envoy, Zoel, and find out the reason."

"O-okay … Klent has responded. The officials on their mother planet are trying to contact Zoel."

Zoel had been staying in the Red Empire's diplomatic embassy on the Klent mother planet. He had only dispatched the Red Empire's troops and had not personally come to the scene.

The two garrisoned fleets of the two Universal Civilizations fired at each other. Many spectators nearby were caught in the crossfire and were blasted into pieces, turning into fireworks.

The other spectators retreated in panic. Countless spaceships turned around, activated their thrusters, and left the edge of the battlefield.

The scene suddenly became chaotic. Everyone was busy dodging the stray bullets, and no one paid attention to the people involved.

On the other side, the Black Star Corps and the Purple Crystal fleet were not affected. They watched as the opposite side turned into a mess. Han Xiao did not announce the news of him allying with the Red Empire. Currently, only Han Xiao and the Red Empire knew about it.

Due to the sudden change, Heber and Sisko's attention was diverted, and they did not have time to care about Han Xiao. Han Xiao and Ames, who were in the middle of the battlefield, did not chase after him either. They looked at the chaotic battle between the Red Empire and the Arcane Church from afar.

Han Xiao suddenly smiled.

"The Red Empire has made their move. This storm is about to end."

"So, this was done by you?" Ames turned to look at Han Xiao and said, "You joined the Crimson Dynasty."

She was also kept in the dark. Before this, she had thought that she was Han Xiao's biggest ally today.

Han Xiao slowly said, "The Tyrant wants to step on me to establish his authority, and Sisko wants to take back the Evolution Cube. I also want to use today's opportunity to expand my influence. I'm a new Beyond Grade A, and I need to accumulate a lot of achievements before I can have a reputation like the Tyrant's. It will take too long. The Tyrant's opportunity is also my opportunity. I can use this battle to gain a lot of prestige and fame. "

Ames raised her brows and said, "It sounds like you don't need my help to deal with the danger today. Or do you think I'm not important enough?"

"Don't misunderstand. I'm just used to being prepared." Han Xiao smiled helplessly. He did not like to put all his eggs in one basket.

…

The Red Empire and the Arcane Church fleet did not engage in an all-out battle. They soon stopped fighting and faced each other. The atmosphere was tense.

Many of the spectators stood far away, still in shock. Their gazes were all focused on the Crimson Dynasty's fleet. Everyone was filled with questions, wanting to know the reason behind the Crimson Dynasty's actions.

At this time, the hundreds of billions of spaceships present received a message from the Red Empire. This was a notice posted on the civilization's exclusive public communication channel, marked with the official authority of the Red Empire. The civilization's exclusive public communication channel was a public channel used by civilizations above the Star System level. It represented an official letter. When a message was sent out, all quantum network terminals in a certain area would receive it.

Simply put, this was equivalent to a loudspeaker for the entire server.

"This is the Red Empire's Shattered Star Ring Garrison K-004 Fleet Commander Teshulio. We hereby issue a warning to the Arcane Church …

"Firstly, this battle is under the supervision of the Red Empire. Any organization that breaks the rules and interferes will be stopped by us. Your interference has already violated the rules.

"Secondly, the Black Star Corps is an ally of the Red Empire. The Evolution Cube currently belongs to the Red Empire. Any organization that wants to fight for it will be viewed as an enemy by the Red Empire!"

Hearing this announcement, be it Klent, Bloodshed Land, Amethyst Civilization, Black Star Corps, or the other spectators, all of them widened their eyes in shock.

Since when did Black Star become an ally of the Red Empire?

After all this time, the Red Empire was not here to help the Tyrant but to help Black Star!

Everyone was in an uproar!

Heber's expression changed drastically. "Why didn't I know about this?"

Jorde was dumbfounded. His mind was blank.

The Bloodshed Land was an ally of the Red Empire, and the Black Star Corps had become an ally of the Red Empire. Did that not mean that they were on the same side?

The two sides had been fighting for ten years, and in the end, they were on the same side?

"What the f * ck …" Summer Night Flower's expression froze, and his face turned pale.

He had originally thought that the biggest advantage of the Bloodshed Land was that they had the Red Empire as their backer and had a bright future. However, now, the Black Star Corps had the exact same promotion channel.

His last hope was shattered, and Summer Night Flower felt as uncomfortable as if he was constipated. His expression was ugly, and he regretted it.

Suddenly, a shadow blocked his line of sight. He turned around and saw that the players around him had unfriendly expressions on their faces. They had surrounded him in layers and layers.

…

"The Black Star Corps actually joined the Red Empire. When did this happen?"

Ralph was visibly moved.

Black Star! Didn't we agree to be each other's angels? Why did you jump into someone else's arms?

I was the one who came first!

In comparison, the Black Star Corps players were all excited by this news.

Becoming enemies with the Red Empire was not a good sign. They had originally been worried about the future of the Black Star Corps, but they did not expect that the two sides had put on a show. The truth was that the army had joined the Red Empire!

The millions of army players were instantly relieved. Becoming an ally of a Universal Civilization meant that the Black Star Corps had a channel to grow and would have more room for development in the future!

All of a sudden, the wavering faith of many players became firm again, and their confidence in the army increased!

"What the f * ck, I thought we were done for."

"The Army Commander actually joined forces with the Red Empire. The Black Star Network Group is not called for nothing."

"From the looks of it, our army will probably be able to last for a few more versions. As expected of a growth-type faction. How terrifying."

"Steady, steady. I'm going to be famous again." Pork Bun smiled like a blooming daisy as he recorded the material.

In the Black Star Corps flagship, the Calamity Grade officers heaved a sigh of relief, followed by ecstasy. "The Army Commander already had a backup plan!"

With the Red Empire as their backer, the Black Star Corps was no longer an ordinary Beyond Grade A organization. Their future would be extremely bright!

The officers were filled with excitement. They were glad that they had made the bet a few years ago and became the core members of the army!

They had not misjudged Black Star!

In the Palace of Hidden Spells, Austin's eyes flashed.

"So that's the case. You really know how to grasp the opportunity well. Not only did you fight with the Tyrant and display your strength in front of the Star Field, but you also used the Crimson Dynasty's announcement to announce your background, expanding your reputation and indirectly resolving the battle with the Tyrant. You single-handedly turned today's event into an event to strengthen your reputation. Heber and Psyker were both tricked by you. You're the one who benefited the most this time …"

An inexplicable smile appeared on Austin's face.

"Very good, you're an ambitious guy. The Shattered Star Ring is finally going to be lively."

…

"No wonder you're so fearless. Turns out you used the Evolution Cube to join the Red Empire …"

Sisko had mixed feelings. The Red Empire wanted the Evolution Cube, so the difficulty of snatching it back was beyond his ability.

Looking at the situation, Sisko sighed in his heart. He then sent a message to the Arcane Church fleet commander.

"Let's retreat."

With the Red Empire's declaration, no matter what Bloodshed Land and Klent thought, they would not stay out of this. Now, it was Black Star and the Tyrant's turn to be on the same side. He was the enemy, and the Arcane Church fleet was alone. They would not be able to do anything if they stayed here and would even be surrounded.

Sisko weighed the pros and cons, and retreating was the best choice. Thus, even if he was unwilling, he still made the decision decisively.

Under everyone's gazes, the Arcane Church fleet slowly retreated and left the battlefield, turning into streams of hyperdrive and disappearing from everyone's sight. The Crimson Dynasty fleet did not stop them. Their goal today was to make the Arcane Church know how to retreat.

"The Arcane Church has retreated!"

"Sisko has also left."

Countless people turned to look at Heber. One of the initiators of the battle had run away, and only the Tyrant was left. The situation was in the hands of the Tyrant.

Originally, everyone thought that the Tyrant and Black Star were enemies, but now, they realized that the two of them were actually on the same side. This battle had become an internal conflict between the allies of the Red Empire.

Thus, the Tyrant's situation became awkward. The Tyrant's confusion earlier did not seem to be fake. Most people were more inclined to believe that Heber was not aware of this situation before. Then, was he still going to fight Black Star?

The situation today was full of twists and turns. No one knew what would happen next.

Bloodshed Land waited for orders. Heber did not immediately return to the battlefield to continue fighting Han Xiao. He narrowed his eyes and looked at Han Xiao from afar. Han Xiao also stared at him without blinking.

Sparks flew between their gazes.

Heber did not move, and the battlefield fell into an eerie silence.

In the spaceship, Heber asked Joad, "Is there a response from Klent?"

"They're still negotiating with the Red Empire …" Joad could tell that Heber's tone was not friendly, so he replied weakly.

…

At the same time, on the mother planet of Klent, the Red Empire's embassy in Klent …

"Envoy Zoel, what do you mean by this? Didn't the Red Empire agree to deal with Black Star together with us? Why did you accept Black Star's alliance?"

The Klent official's protest came from the communicator. Zoel looked up and slowly said, "I don't think I ever agreed to this request. I only sent the garrison troops to the scene to help our allies. Klent is our ally, and so is Black Star. We're only targeting Sisko and the Arcane Church behind him. You misunderstood me."

"But you didn't inform us that Black Star is joining us!"

"Oh?" Zoel raised his brows and said, "Do we have to inform you immediately when we form an alliance with any organization? Then, do you want the dynasty to open up all military secrets to you?"
